title: The Perfect Stalker
description: A woman with a personality disorder and a murderous past, invents a stalker with which she hopes to arouse the attention of her new neighbour.

title: Eve of Abduction
description: After a single mother gets engaged she begins to receive messages from an anonymous stalker, threatening to kidnap her daughter if she does not break off the engagement. The threats persist and her daughter is taken.

description: Jenna and Charlie reunite in Ireland after five years, and Jenna must choose between love and her dreams.

description: Just three days before their wedding day, Jess and Max are on the verge of calling it off. But the groom's brother will stop at nothing to ensure that this meant-to-be couple get hitched once and for all.

description: When her daughter is rescued from a deadly attack by a stranger, a famous novelist joins the police to investigate. They soon discover the saviour's hidden past.

description: Emily, who is pregnant, quickly becomes friends with Kelly, her new neighbour. Though Kelly claims to be pregnant, she has in fact been faking pregnancy in order to steal Emily's baby.
